title: Output-write boundary check for first failing Q8_0 up-skip record

candidate.name: Q8_0 output-write max_calls=103/104 boundary check
candidate.why_this_step: Output-write runs CPU fallback first and then overwrites dst. If max_calls=104 fails here too, record 103 is numerically/token unstable. If it passes, the pre-fallback skip path has a side effect unrelated to the CUDA arithmetic output.
candidate.expected_ram_pressure: Same 16GB/no-swap cgroup; CPU fallback remains enabled, so this is correctness/root-cause only.
candidate.expected_ttft_impact: Not evaluated; this is not a performance run.

correctness_gate.check: For each max_calls value, run llama-results --check --top1-report with GGML_MOE_STREAM_Q80_WRITE_NAME_FILTER=blk.0.ffn_up_exps.weight and --top1-fail-on-mismatch.
correctness_gate.required_report: q80-write-report.csv with local max_abs/mean_abs for records around 100-103

promotion_rule: This run cannot be promoted as SOTA. It only classifies the first bad skip record.
